ReportQueryDefinition.Name: Исторический срез сессий печати
ReportQueryDefinition.Command: SELECT ph.printed_at, ph.template_description, ph.recipient_address_snapshot, ph.sender_address_snapshot, ph.copy_count, pj.printer_name, pj.paper_size_name, pj.status FROM print_history ph JOIN print_jobs pj ON ph.print_job_id = pj.id WHERE ph.printed_at BETWEEN :DateFrom AND :DateTo ORDER BY ph.printed_at DESC;

SELECT ph.printed_at, ph.template_description, ph.recipient_address_snapshot, ph.sender_address_snapshot, ph.copy_count, pj.printer_name, pj.paper_size_name, pj.status FROM print_history ph JOIN print_jobs pj ON ph.print_job_id = pj.id WHERE ph.printed_at BETWEEN :DateFrom AND :DateTo ORDER BY ph.printed_at DESC;
